correctness.rationale: At integer dilation m and height k the exact lattice slice is (1+a(m-k)+bk)(1+b(m-k)+ak); summing k=0,...,m recovers the displayed cubic Ehrhart coefficients and checks constant L(0)=1. Transforming the polynomial to basis m^i(m+1)^(3-i) yields magic (1,a+b-2-(a-b)²/6,((a-1)²+(a-1)(b-1)+(b-1)²)/3,0); all but the linear term are nonnegative. Ordinary Ehrhart coefficient linear is a+b+1-(a-b)²/6. Boundary congruence requires delta=6k and a+b same parity; magic equality gives (3k²+3k+1,3k²-3k+1), while ordinary equality has parity contradiction. With a=b+t,b>=1, normalized volume t²+6bt+6b²; sign failure forces t>=7 (magic) or t>=9 (Ehrhart), uniquely minimized at (b,t)=(1,7),(1,9), volumes 97,141. Independently recomputed exact fractions and height sums for six distinct parameter pairs; checker also covers 3600 bounded pairs, not used for universal claim.
residual_risks: All thresholds require positive integral a,b; for arbitrary reals the parity boundary conclusions change. Smoothness, triangulation are partly taken from Ferroni with an independent primitive-ray argument for smoothness.

value.rationale: The two different positivity thresholds in a natural smooth eight-vertex three-dimensional lattice-polytope family locate a sharp arithmetic separation between magic and ordinary Ehrhart positivity. Exact equality families and first counterexample volumes are useful benchmarks for positivity conjectures in smooth IDP polytopes, beyond simply recomputing an isolated h*-vector.
residual_risks: The general polynomial itself is a direct specialization of established Cayley-box enumeration; value resides narrowly in the complete integer classification and sharp failure minima.

final_claim: For positive integer a,b the smooth three-dimensional swapped-rectangle Cayley polytope has Ehrhart L(m)=[(a²+4ab+b²)/6]m³+(ab+a+b)m²+[a+b+1-(a-b)²/6]m+1; magic iff (a-b)²<=6(a+b-2), ordinary Ehrhart iff (a-b)²<6(a+b+1), magic equality explicit, ordinary equality impossible, and first failure normalized volumes 97 and 141.
limitations: Family is only positive integer swapped rectangular layers of unit separation, no global smooth polytope extremal claim.
Cayley-box general formula and unimodular triangulation are prior work; priority of elementary specialization remains qualified.
